author: The Spiffing Brit
description:
Rust Global Warfare 4 Is here! This is a 4 day Event run by the legendary  @FancyOrb  inside Rust as 500 players and hundreds of creators must roleplay, expand and conquer a scale recreation of our planet earth. 

Twitch Drop POV: https://www.twitch.tv/thespiffingbrit

This season there are some fun additions like the moon which we might be able to claim as our own for tea growing. The world will be filled with some famous  twitch streamers and youtubers that you might recognise from Ser Winter, Ohmwrecker, and theburntpeanut as well as hundreds that I do not recognise but look forward to introducing to them. Now myself and some wonderful creator friends have decided to work together and settle on  New Zealand or as  it shall now be named New tealand! Our plan is to build an incredible tea based empire and have in infinite amount of funny moments in rust. 

So who is joining me! Well hopping in and out of the server we should be joined by ItsJabo,  Hazzor, Willjum, TeaGuyTom, Brit and
title: RUST GLOBAL WARFARE 4 - FINISHING The Tea Kingdom (New Tealand POV Day 4) #rust #live #tea
